annotations.title: European Corporate Tax, LEI, EORI & National ID Validator API

description: European Corporate Tax, LEI, EORI & National ID Validator API: Validate LEI, EORI, SIREN/SIRET, Steuer-ID, Codice Fiscale, NIF/CIF, NIP, BSN, CRN & EIN checksums. (Endpoint: POST /v1/eu-id-validator)

country_hint.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code ('FR', 'DE', 'IT', 'ES', 'PL', 'NL', 'GB', 'US', 'EU') to disambiguate numeric lengths in AUTO mode.

type.description: Identifier type to validate, or 'AUTO' to classify automatically from structure and country hint.

value.description: Raw corporate or tax identifier string (LEI, EORI, FR SIREN/SIRET, DE Steuer-ID, IT Codice Fiscale, ES NIF/NIE/CIF, PL NIP/PESEL, NL BSN/RSIN, GB CRN, or US EIN).

name: tinplate_eu_id_validator
